capabilities: Recognize text on images in notes using OCR
Replace an image with its recognized text
Append recognized text to the image
Insert recognized text as image alt text
Choose recognition language per run or in settings
problem: Obsidian cannot extract text from images, so text embedded in screenshots or photos must be retyped manually.

relations.evidence: This plugin uses tesseract.js to recognize text.

summary: OCR plugin that recognizes text on images in a note via commands that append or replace text or set alt text.
